note: 📣 Hill News for the HtH Leaderboard: the strip on top of the board, all season. Each item: icon, title, body (or html), optional at (ISO time: shows from then, with a NEW tag for 24 hours), optional until (ISO time: gone after). Newest first; the latest three show, the rest are one tap away. The Opening Day intro runs for 24 hours from the board's openingDay stamp; start/end here are only a fallback.

drops.title: N*S takes the mound.
drops.body: Ajax Assassins were the last Hold the Hill club standing in the Black Friday Brawl, so N*S opens Season 1 as the Ace. The other grand finalist showed up in a club that isn't on the Hill, which is a lot like bringing a tennis racket to batting practice.

drops.title: The commish starts in the basement.
drops.body: Terrapin Station opens the season at #5. Officially it's for ethical reasons. Unofficially, he lost.

drops.title: 1,000 Brawl Bucks for everybody.
drops.body: Bets and head-to-head wagers go up to 42% of your stack (250 tops). The sportsbook is not a licensed financial advisor, and neither is anyone in the chat.

drops.title: The Farm is open for business.
drops.body: Young clubs, big dreams, no reach limit. Kingdom Keys leads the Farm into the new season.

drops.title: Fresh season, clean slate.
drops.body: Every record is 0-0 and the ladder is set in sign-up order. Fresh chalk on the base lines, fresh grudges in the dugout. Charge early, charge often.
